text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is filled with a strange, buzzing energy, and the reason is simple. Apart from Zenno Rob Roy and Special Week…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Air Groove and Fuji Kiseki are also joining the fray. All have made a name for themselves in the G1. The excitement is palpable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In contrast to her rivals, Eishin Flash's fire burns quietly—after all, the more challenging the race, the more worthwhile it is to compete in.
